title: ZK STARK/SNARK Prime Field Addition Chains (Plonky3: Goldilocks, BabyBear, KoalaBear, Mersenne31, BN254)
description: Ten pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) kernel-verified shortest addition-chain hill-climb tracks for Plonky3's five production ZK prime fields — Goldilocks (2^64-2^32+1), BabyBear (2^31-2^27+1), KoalaBear (2^31-2^24+1), Mersenne31 (2^31-1), and BN254 — covering both Fermat field inversions (`p-2`) and Rescue/Poseidon inverse S-box roots (`1/7`, `1/3`, `1/5` mod `p-1`) where Plonky3's own `exponentiation.rs` invites shorter chains. Pinned verbatim to `Plonky3/Plonky3@0d803737b6` (Apache-2.0).

tasks.title: Goldilocks p-2: minimize addition-chain length (baseline 125)
tasks.description: Minimize addition-chain length for Plonky3 Goldilocks p-2 (seeded at 125 steps; Plonky3/known frontier: ~72). Edit `ZkAddChain/ChainGoldilocksInv.lean` (`ZkAddChain.score_goldilocks_inv` and `ZkAddChain.steps_goldilocks_inv`). Frozen Lean 4.36.0 kernel proofs verify well-formedness, step count, exact target value, and algebraic exponentiation soundness.
